ADVISOR DESIGN SIGNOFF: APPROVED WITH BINDING AMENDMENTS — STORY-1843 B SNAPSHOT/API SKETCH v1 by codex2, canonical sketch and /tmp/codex2-story1843-B-snapshot-sketch.txt. This approves concrete design choices inside signed A-E, not implementation completion, deployment, migration, or an authority grant.
1. Core typed context/logical snapshot is accepted: requested CheckoutRoot independent of StoreRoot, verified same common-Git product sources, canonical once, explicit provenance/coverage/errors and authorized audience BEFORE ID/body/detail projection. CLI/MCP/TUI and all inventoried ordinary readers consume it. Keep source-local mutation snapshot types for digest/transport/archive/retract/delete/migration/lifecycle; a global view never grants write scope. Retain known historical/operator inspection separately. No string-to-private-authority constructor or process/test environment switch. Existing source/per-recipient privacy and inherited-parent filtering remain required; do not invent UUID ownership of legacy-addressed deliveries. D remains necessary.
2. Receipt ruling: explicit per-ID, same logical recipient/audience evidence is accepted. A historical timestamp watermark ALONE cannot prove that a late-arriving old-timestamp LOCAL ID was present when that watermark was set. Therefore do not turn a current local directory listing into retroactive exact read evidence. Import/freeze only corroborated ID coverage, preserving evidence origin and unknown time; absent corroboration stays UnknownLegacy/visible-unread-compatible, never a fabricated Seen/precise latency. No max-watermark union, and a later old writer changing a watermark cannot expand frozen IDs. Do not conflate ambiguous legacy read history with unreadable source/authority: a fully delivered, currently authorized stable snapshot may resolve those selected IDs through a NEW explicit ACK; unknown unrelated legacy history must not make all future reads permanently unacknowledgeable. True source/receipt corruption or ownership uncertainty retains fail-closed eligibility. Add a late old-timestamp arrival into the SAME local source after legacy watermark, as well as unknown sibling/canonical cases.
3. Post-successful-output ACK is approved as an EXPLICIT successor behavior to BUG-1482's pre-output/full-inbox marking. Record this rationale in the existing mail docs and update that regression by name; do not reopen or erase historical completion credit. Only full body records actually selected/serialized and successfully flushed can be planned; notices/ID-only wakes/audit views never ACK. Broken output/serialization means no ACK, accepting a possible duplicate over silent loss. Transport flush is not proof a human read it. MCP default peek is unchanged; explicit mark_seen uses a response-scoped prepared plan, no ambient mutable last-plan slot or tool-method early side effect. Direct unit-return tests must exercise the real response delivery boundary for marking behavior.
4. ACK success/failure must be honest: a response emitted before publication may say ack_requested, never ack_committed. If post-flush commit fails, use a defined observable diagnostic/next-query outcome with no false success, idempotent safe retry, and no unsolicited second JSON-RPC response or body-bearing error log. Define/test bounded exact error handling for CLI exit, real MCP stdio and TUI. Commit validates SAME selected IDs/fingerprints/recipient/source generation/current authority; unrelated arrival cannot expand plan. Retirement/tombstone/ownership conflict refuses without resurrection.
5. Shared receipt anchor under the signed private common-Git namespace is accepted with strict owned no-follow bounded regular IO, one atomic idempotent publication and nonblocking/bounded receipt lock. Explicit byte/ID/entry/recipient bounds and full-ledger behavior must preserve existing evidence, never prune unknown mail or mark success after refusal. Keep source receipts intact as inputs; no cleanup or live migration authorized. Do not mint C's source lifecycle generation from path/mtime alone; B must state current-source identity coverage versus verified C retention generation, with retention unestablished until C. Missing or retired sources cannot become globally caught-up by omission.
6. No durable inbox cache is needed for v1. Canonical-once/in-memory source table, exact relevant-ID receipt lookup and request-local memoization are accepted. Any long-lived parsed-byte reuse must refresh inventory, authority and source/receipt evidence; cached absence/mtime cannot certify caught-up. Aggregate deadline/byte/entry/root budget includes inventory/context/receipt work. Proposed explicit-read2s profile is accepted as a NEW documented bounded-read profile, not as proof of adequate loaded-host/cold performance or permission to change TASK2347's reviewed budget/sufficiency. Passive callers retain existing short caps. Error/timeout yields typed partial/unknown with no implicit ACK or stale-empty success. Bound outputs and protect private paths/IDs in errors.
7. IMPLEMENTATION PREREQUISITES REMAIN: TASK-2345 deterministic pure identity seam; TASK-2346 justified dead lookup cleanup; and signed concrete REST/MCP/core writer + destructive-entry + actual held-lock/order inventory BEFORE B/C implementation. This sketch explicitly did not finish that inventory. Inventory must show that re-resolving authority while holding receipt lock does NOT acquire a seat/store/lifecycle lock in reverse order. If it does, use checked pre-lock facts plus read-only versioned revalidation/held-lock helpers, not an undocumented nested lock. C's lifecycle-before-receipt protocol and all removal/reset/reuse/old-mutator fencing remain required. Source/lifecycle writes are not authorized merely because reader API choices are approved. These are existing signed prerequisites, not a request for operator permission; doers can perform the inventory and A preparation under existing scope.
8. B1/B2 non-completing Refs slices are accepted, with one shared actual-Git conformance matrix across ALL named adapters. Add same-source legacy late arrival, mixed old-writer watermark mutation, per-response concurrent MCP ACK plans, output failure/publication failure observable outcomes, full-ledger refusal, conflicting payload/audience and lifecycle/authority lock-order cases. Retain private/shared/human/native-resume, no alias, same-ID receipt replicas, canonical-once, roots/partial/cycle/FIFO/link and source removal cases. B helper or watcher success alone is not B completion; full A-E, relay STORY122 and real deployment proofs remain.
Local gates remain one meaningful targeted filtered run+fast; touched/compile only shared test infra or>10files. No broad runtime, slot bypass, nested Cargo timeout, real mail/queue/ACK/install/migration tests. Independent STRICT exact-head review/CI before integration. This signoff does not change codex2's reviewer authority or existing ready-review priority.
subject: STORY1843 B design signed; legacy evidence and delivery boundary bindings
